files.bin/rotate.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
source config/journal.env
source lib/rotate.sh
rotate_journal
files.docs/signals.md:
# Ledger signals
USR1 reopens log handles after rotation. TERM stops the daemon.

# journal-gzip-rotation

路径均相对于仓库根目录。运维入口和库函数分开维护。
